title: R′ Abba, son of R′ Yose’s brother

paragraphs: Shekalim, chapter 2: so Hyman reports Seder HaDorot citing it. The text Hyman uses reads Rabbi Abba Mari, or R′ Abba Mari, the brother of R′ Yose; see his entry.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading describes a nephew of Rabbi Yose; the quoted variant describes a brother. Both relationships are retained.

The consulted Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim chapter 2 paragraphs explicitly name Rabbi Abba Mari, supporting the first local form. They do not establish the separate brother variant or the supplied heading Abba son of Yose’s brother; their abbreviated personal titles remain R′, including Yose. Seder HaDorot and the brother reading are Hyman’s reports, not freshly collated here. The nephew heading and brother variant, including the existing note, are retained without combining the relationships or identifying the parties.
